mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.3% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.3%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month MA) fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime (INDPRO declines > 0.5% monthly), reduced industrial output signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (INDPRO decline > 0.5% monthly), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized inflation rate above 3.0% (derived from CPIAUCSL) signals central bank tightening and reduced corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly growth rate of real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth is above the 3-year average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 2050 thousand units signal strong consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (HOUST > 2050), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% over 3 months), higher borrowing costs reduce corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5% in 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
